title: Harbour Air

services.name: Charter flights
services.desc: From executive retreats and luxury wilderness lodges to championship golf getaways and seamless resort connections, we deliver elevated charter experiences across British Columbia and the Pacific Northwest. When time matters, we make group travel simple, seamless, and efficient. Harbour Air operates the largest seaplane fleet in North America, with aircraft that can comfortably seat up to 19 passengers. Our fleet includes the Twin Otter, Single Otter, Cessna Caravan, and the iconic De Havilland Beaver.
